sentences.text: Hello everyone! Welcome to the Slow English Podcast. My name is Emili. In this podcast,
we speak very slowly. We use easy English. We repeat important words. Today, we travel
to North Africa. We go to Algeria. Our city today is Gardaia. Gardaia is unique. Gardaia
is traditional. Gardaia is in the desert. Please relax. Please listen slowly. Let's
begin our journey. Part 2, Algeria and Africa. Algeria is a large country in
Africa. It is in the north of the continent. Algeria has the Mediterranean Sea. Algeria
has mountains. Algeria has a very big desert. The desert is called the Sahara. Many cities
are inside the desert. Gardaia is one of them. It is very special. Part 3, where is Gardaia?
Gardaia is in the central north of Algeria. It is in the Sahara Desert. The land is dry.
The air is warm. The city is not near the sea. It is far from big modern cities. Gardaia
feels quiet. Gardaia feels protected. Part 4, weather and climate. Gardaia has a desert
climate. Summer is very hot. The sun is strong. Winter is cooler. Nights can be cold. Rain is
rare. Water is very important. People plan life with the weather. Life moves slowly.
Part 5, a city with deep history. Gardaia is an old city. People lived here many
centuries ago. The city was built with care. It was built to survive the desert. Houses
are close together. Streets are narrow. History lives in the walls. The past is still alive.
Part 6, the old city design. Gardaia has a special city design. Everything has a place.
The mosque is in the center. Homes are around it. The design helps people live together.
It helps people stay cool. This city is very smart. It shows human wisdom. Part 7,
houses and colors. Houses in Gardaia are simple. Colors are soft. White, beige and
earth colors are common. They reflect the sun. Windows are small. Doors are strong.
Homes protect people from heat. Homes protect privacy. Part 8, culture and community.
Community is very important here. People help each other. Traditions are strong. Rules are respected.
Life is organized. Life is balanced. People live with respect. People live with care.
Sad a part 9, daily life in Gardaia. Daily life starts early. People avoid the hot hours.
They work in the morning. They rest at midday. In the evening people meet. They talk and drink tea.
Life is simple. Life is steady. Part 10, food and daily meals.
Food in Gardaia is traditional. People eat bread and vegetables. Meals are not heavy.
Water is important. Families eat together. Food is shared. Eating is calm. Eating is respectful.
Part 11, silence and desert life. The desert around Gardaia is quiet. There is a lot of silence.
At night the sky is full of stars. The air feels clean. Silence brings peace.

Gardaia is a city of desert wisdom. Community life, tradition, silence and balance.
It is not modern. It is not fast. It is deep. It is meaningful.
